# Strict-mode-dependent branches (CONFIGS.md section B; every `J->strict` /
# `F->strict` test in the C source). The harness runs each line with flags=0 and
# with flags=JS_STRICT, so almost every line below is deliberately written to
# produce a DIFFERENT observable value in the two modes.
#
# HARNESS FORMAT: one snippet per line; `\n` -> newline, `\t` -> tab.

# --- js_setvar: assignment to an undeclared variable (jsrun.c:1132) ---
(function(){try{ undeclaredA=1; return 'ok:'+undeclaredA }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
(function(){try{ undeclaredB=undeclaredB2=1; return 'ok' }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
(function(){try{ for (undeclaredC in {k:1}) ; return 'ok:'+undeclaredC }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
(function(){try{ for (undeclX=0; undeclX<1; undeclX++) ; return 'ok:'+undeclX }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
(function(){try{ undeclY=1, undeclZ=2; return 'ok' }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()

# --- jsR_setproperty: read-only built-in slots reached through a primitive /
#     regexp receiver (jsrun.c:790-800). NOTE the "transient object" branch at
#     jsrun.c:780-785 is unreachable from JS because jsV_toobject rewrites the
#     stack slot to JS_TOBJECT before `transient` is computed (jsrun.c:1788-1791).

(function(){var r=/x/g; try{ r.global=false; return 'ok:'+r.global }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
(function(){try{ 'ab'.length=9; return 'ok' }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()

(function(){var s='abc'; try{ s[0]='z'; return 'ok:'+s }catch(e){ return e.name+': '+e.message }})()
